        c.bond_id,

predicted_sql:
WITH virtual_school_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        s."School" AS school_name,
        s."County",
        AVG(sa."AvgScrRead") AS avg_reading_score
    FROM "schools" s
    JOIN "satscores" sa ON s."CDSCode" = sa."cds"
    WHERE s."Virtual" = 'F'
    GROUP BY s."School", s."County"
),
ranked_schools AS (
    SELECT 
        school_name,
        "County",
        avg_reading_score,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "County" ORDER BY avg_reading_score DESC NULLS LAST) AS county_rank

)

FROM ranked_schools
WHERE county_rank <= 5
ORDER BY "County", county_rank;
